capabilities: Patch double-click selection to select Chinese words in the editor
Patch Vim word motions to respect Chinese word boundaries
Switch between the system segmentation engine and jieba
Install or import the jieba WASM component and manage its IndexedDB cache
disambiguation: It only patches how words are selected and navigated; it does not transform or rewrite text.
extras: Since v1.8.0 the system's built-in segmenter is the default; the jieba WASM component is optional, downloaded via a settings action, and cached in IndexedDB per device (Obsidian Sync does not sync it). The README warns to fully reload Obsidian after disabling the plugin to remove its Vim patches.
intentEvidence: Adds Simplified Chinese word splitting support for the editor and Vim mode
problem: Obsidian's default word splitting does not handle Chinese text, so double-click selects whole runs of characters and Vim word motions stop at the wrong places.

relations.evidence: Special Thanks to @fengkx for jieba-wasm module
若你需要结合 omnisearch 插件使用

summary: Patches the editor and Vim mode so Simplified Chinese text is split into words for double-click selection and word-wise cursor movement.
